propositions: Compaction must work in environments without CI and without local cron, requiring an operation-linked fallback trigger that does not reintroduce the 13m53s lock hold from the original close-path compaction.

The compact-all command selects tickets in two arms: backfill (no SNAPSHOT and at least one foldable event) and recurrence (foldable count exceeding threshold), both converging after a fold places the ticket under threshold.
A scheduled 6-hourly sweep via GitHub Actions reuses the reconcile-bridge recipe to fold and push compaction from an ephemeral runner without accumulating state.

Out-of-band compaction spawns a detached worker after close completes and releases the store lock, using a stamped advisory lock to serialize compactors and standing aside when another writer holds the store lock.

Selection and counting must be honest: the fold is reused to identify foldable events and predict work, artifacts are observed (snapshot files before/after) rather than return codes to count actual work, and unknown-type events and snapshot files themselves are excluded from foldable count.
